name: Sarnafil Walkway Pad PVC
paste:
SARNAFIL® WALKWAY PAD PVC: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sarnafil_walkwaypadpvc.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC is made of high quality PVC membrane by injection moulding procedure.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC is used to provide a durable slip resisting walkway for roof maintenance or access on any Sarnafil® PVC or Sikaplan® PVC roofing system.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Injection moulded PVC Walkway Pad
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Reaction to fire according to EN 13501-1
    - Slip resistance according to BS 7976-2, PTV >50
    - Quality management system EN ISO 9001/14001
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 13501-1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards; test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1); System Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
    - BS 7976-2: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN ISO 9001/14001: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Resistant to permanent UV irradiation
    - Outstanding slip resistant surface
    - Hot air welding without use of open flames
    - Rainwater drainage from beneath the Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC is provided by a network of moulded channels
    - Recyclable
    - Interlocking alignment tabs
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC)
2.6 Appearance and colour.
    | Colour | Dark grey |
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Surface: Chevron pattern with an alternating rib height of the embossing
    - Length: 600 mm (+3 mm / -3 mm)
    - Width: 600 mm (+3 mm / -3 mm) without welding tabs
    - Mass per area: 2.3 kg/pad
2.8 System structure.
    | Compatible products: | Sarnafil® G 410 -types |
    | Sarnafil® S 327 -types |
    | Sikaplan® G / VG / VGWT / S / SG / SGK |
    (System build-up table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows. Refer to the data sheet (page 2) for the layout.)
2.9 Reaction to fire. Class E
    Test method printed: EN 13501-1
2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Cartons with 20 pads
    - Shelf life: Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC does not expire during correct storage.
    - Storage conditions: Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC shall be stored in dry conditions.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: 7 mm (+0.1 mm / -0.1 mm) including 3 / 5 mm non slip chevron pattern embossing
4.3 Application method / tools. According to the valid installation instructions for Sarnafil®. Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC is installed on site by hot air welding the welding tabs directly onto the Sarnafil® G/S or Sikaplan® PVC membrane.
    - Mark a line (e.g. chalk line) in the direction of the installation
    - Lay the walkway pads along the marked line
    - If arranged in a row, move the pads against the two spacers
    - Overlap the welding tabs in the running direction of the welding machine
4.4 Application.
    - Installation works must be carried out only by Sika instructed contractors for roofing.
    - Installation of some ancillary products, e.g. contact adhesives / cleaners is limited to temperatures above +5 °C. Please observe information given by Product Data Sheets. Special measures may be compulsory for installation below +5 °C ambient temperature due to safety requirements in accordance with national regulations.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations - Geographical / Climate.
    - The use of Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C.
    - Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. -20 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. -30 °C min. / +60 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.5):
    - The use of Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC is limited to geographical locations with average monthly minimum temperatures of -50 °C.
    - Permanent ambient temperature during use is limited to +50 °C.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Reaction to fire: Class E EN 13501-1
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sarnafil® Walkway Pad PVC, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sarnafil_walkwaypadpvc.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
